root_cause_clusters.RC_SOURCE_NORMALIZATION: Source adapters diverge on canonical identity, immutable capture, capability reporting, and malformed-record isolation.
root_cause_clusters.RC_EVENT_DURABILITY: Listener identity, durable acknowledgement, deduplication, and bounded backpressure are incomplete.
root_cause_clusters.RC_REDUCER_CONVERGENCE: Full and incremental paths disagree on normalization, ordering, deletion, idempotency, and checkpoints.
root_cause_clusters.RC_ANALYSIS_SEMANTICS: Queue, build, lineage, and plugin analyses omit operational state needed for correct conclusions.
root_cause_clusters.RC_GENERATION_LIFECYCLE: Publication, recovery, migration, retention, compaction, and shutdown lack one fenced immutable lifecycle.
root_cause_clusters.RC_AUTHORIZED_QUERY: Authorization occurs after correlation, aggregation, sorting, or pagination.
root_cause_clusters.RC_OPERABILITY: CLI, HTTP, health, and deterministic-home runs do not share one query and readiness contract.
